title: demo-api OOMKilled
summary: The demo-api pod in the sentinel namespace was OOMKilled three times in 10 minutes. Memory limit was set to 64Mi; the uvicorn worker overshot it under load. Resolution: raised the memory limit to 256Mi and redeployed via ArgoCD. Root cause: the default worker count of 4 multiplied the per-worker RSS beyond the pod limit.

title: CrashLoopBackOff on qdrant
summary: Qdrant replica entered CrashLoopBackOff after a node reboot. The PVC reattached to a different worker node but the snapshot directory was stale. Resolution: deleted the stale snapshot lock file and restarted the pod. Root cause: kind's local-path provisioner does not guarantee PVC stickiness across node restarts.

title: Prometheus target down: kube-controller-manager
summary: The kube-controller-manager target showed as down in Prometheus. This is expected on kind clusters because the control-plane does not expose a scrape-friendly endpoint. No action required; the alert was silenced in Alertmanager.
